//jsx: Preact's automatic runtime — the UI screens are .tsx and there is no React in this package. tsc only needs it for TYPES; at bundle time the emitted `preact/jsx-runtime` specifier is aliased to the vendor bundle in BOTH package.json alias maps, because Parcel reads its JSX config from whatever it decided its project root is (JSTransformer.js:176 reads tsconfig from the project root, not from the asset) and this repo cannot pin that. Left unaliased, Parcel resolves node_modules/preact/jsx-runtime and the chunk ends up with a SECOND preact.
//types: `bun-types` types the `bun:test` imports in test/**. It is depended on DIRECTLY rather than through `@types/bun`, which installs to node_modules/@types and is therefore auto-included by every package in the monorepo that does not pin `types` — that broke @mediajel/tracker-core's check, because bun's global `fetch` type carries a `preconnect` property that tracker-core's fetch wrapper does not. Naming it here also keeps @types/node's globals from shadowing the DOM lib the widget actually runs against.
//include: interface.ts carries tracker-core's shared `declare global { Window }` augmentation; ambient globals only apply to compilations that include the file, so each consumer pulls it in.
